item.title: U.S. Rep. Barry Moore and Sheriff Scott Byrd: We applaud Trump's commitment to our nation's law enforcement
item.description: In Coffee County and across Alabama, we’ve seen firsthand what long hours and hard work looks like. Law enforcement isn’t a 9-to-5 job. It’s nights, weekends, holidays, and emergency calls that can’t wait. item.title: Democrat House District 82 candidate Terrence Johnson arrested for Opelika daycare arsons
item.description: A Democrat candidate for House District 82 was arrested on Wednesday in an arson investigation of two separate fires at two daycare facilities in Opelika in January.Opelika Police arrested Terrence Kareem Johnson, of Tuskegee, on two counts of second-degree arson after an investigation into two separate fires that occurred at childcare facilities in January. item.description: During a Wednesday appearance on Huntsville WVNN's "The Yaffee Program," U.S. Rep.
